name: @withmethod/runtime
description: Open-source Method validator and local executor

scripts.check: npm run schema -- --check && npm test && npm run check:types
scripts.types: tsc --allowJs --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir types --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck src/*.js
scripts.check:types: npm run types && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 test/types.mts
